response: We're introducing Saved Views, a new way to organize how your team works. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture any combination of filters, grouping, and sorting as a Saved View and return to it in one click. Saved Views is available today for every customer, included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can create and save up to 50 views, whether you're tracking overdue tasks, a specific sprint, or work assigned to you. Views aren't limited to personal use, either: any Saved View can be shared with your team, so everyone sees the same filtered list without repeating setup work. This makes it easier to standardize how your team tracks progress, run recurring status checks, and hand off context between teammates without extra explanation. Give it a try on your next project and see how much time it saves. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
